snippet.title: Appel Platformer | Scratch Game Blog
snippet.description:
Appel Platformer is an upcoming Scratch Game that I'm working ok - It will be a new griffpatch original, but is based with permission on the awesome Appelmoeshapje created by Legobouwer9 on Scratch!

Feel free to leave comments, let me know if you are as excited as me! Tell me what you are most looking forward to :)

I have been developing this platforming game in Scratch for the last 3 months and so this video is an update for those on Scratch who want to know what Griffpatch's next game will be like!

🚀 *Boost Your Creativity with Griffpatch*
The Griffpatch Academy will take you from "Gamer to Game Creator"
Learn more at 👉 https://griffpatch.academy 👈

😺 Scratch was developed by the Lifelong Kindergarten Group at the MIT Media Lab. See http://scratch.mit.edu

#griffpatch #scratch #platformer #Appel #Appelmoeshapje
